svg.title: HE-02.1 animated: plant run F-07
svg.desc: Synthetic (DSR-12), no evidence credit. Looping animation of plant run F-07 for HE-02.1: the Corolla's lateral offset on a straightened road from 1 s before the fault to 4.3 s after it, the offset plot with a moving cursor and the 0.5 s FTTI band, and the events: fault: EPS fault: LKA_STATE 9, assist lost at 0.00 s; panda refuses LKA frames at 0.00 s; panda revokes steering authority at 0.05 s; panda siren (the driver's cue) at 0.79 s; body on the 3.7 m lane line at 1.97 s; driver starts to correct at 2.29 s.
svg.text: Vehicle goes straight in the curve and departs the lane
Plant run F-07: left curve at R_ODD, fault at curve entry
road straightened; the car keeps its place, the road moves
body on the 3.7 m lane line (0.96 m)

g.text: fault: EPS fault: LKA_STATE 9, assist lost
body on the 3.7 m lane line
